apps/desktop.method: Sum printed Bun passing-case durations by file; skipped cases contribute zero. These omit module loading/cleanup/reporting overhead; weigh applies the existing one-second scheduling floor. Full Windows Bun elapsed was 594.10s.
apps/desktop.windows: Measured printed case durations, not elapsed file wall time. Unobserved new files use existing byte-rate estimates.
apps/desktop.linux: Estimate copied from Windows case durations; Linux Desktop did not produce complete buffered output. Not a Linux measurement.

movedCases.method: Exact printed test title found in unchanged moved source body; subtract from original file and assign once to new owner.
